components: target: the wine in the bowl (body seen through the glass wall, the reflective liquid surface, the meniscus ring)
margin: ~0.012 in x / ~0.006 in y (about half the band) past the wine outline at the sides and bottom, ~12 px above the meniscus ring, stopping at the top of the clear knob
rationale: The mask is the wine volume only: the liquid-surface ellipse with its meniscus ring and the dark body down to the bottom of the bowl, with about half a feather band of margin over the thin glass wall, while the glass above the liquid level, the knob, the red stem, the foot and the granite stay outside; the meniscus ring and the wall sit in the feather band, which is the usual band tradeoff. Ambiguous: the glossy dark foot shows a dome-shaped reflection of the wine-filled bowl that would lighten with white wine, but it is excluded because the foot is listed as must-not-change; no red cast on the granite is visible.
